I've implemented toolchain tracking in the Twister test runner, matching the exact source changes from the upstream Zephyr commit that introduced this feature (11e656bb, "twister: support testing multiple toolchain variants") — which is precisely the era of this repo (v4.0.99). No files under `tests/` were touched.

## Changes made

**`testinstance.py`** — `TestInstance.__init__` now accepts `toolchain`, stores it as `self.toolchain`, includes it in `self.name` (`platform/toolchain/testsuite.name`), and inserts it into `build_dir` right after `platform.normalized_name` for both the detailed and non-detailed path branches.

**`testplan.py`**
- Added `import itertools`.
- `apply_filters`: removed the single `toolchain = self.env.toolchain` line and replaced the `for plat in platform_scope` loop with `itertools.product(ts.integration_toolchains or [None], platform_scope)`. Each iteration picks the explicit integration toolchain, or defaults to `zephyr`/`self.env.toolchain` (or `host` for `posix`/`unit` arches) — so combinations are generated regardless of `--integration`. Instances are built via `TestInstance(ts, plat, toolchain, ...)`, and the toolchain-support filter was simplified to just the `plat.supported_toolchains` check.
- `load_from_file`: reads `toolchain = ts["toolchain"]` and passes it to `TestInstance`. Instance keys thus follow `platform/toolchain/name`.
- `add_instances` continues keying on `instance.name`, which now carries the toolchain.

**`runner.py`**
- `run_cmake`: appends `-DZEPHYR_TOOLCHAIN_VARIANT=<toolchain>` when a toolchain is set.
- `parse_generated`: the three filter/quarantine result keys now include `self.instance.toolchain` (`platform/toolchain/test_path`).
- `report_out`: appends ` <toolchain>` to the progress log, yielding `(handler_type: dut, elapsed_time <toolchain>)` for runs and `(build <toolchain>)` for build-only.

**`reports.py`** — serializes `suite['toolchain']` into the test plan JSON.

**`package.py`** — the packaged output directory path now includes the toolchain segment (`outdir/platform/toolchain/name`), plus utf-8 encoding on the JSON open.

**`config_parser.py`** / **`testsuite-schema.yaml`** — added the `integration_toolchains` list key.

All modules compile, both `TestInstance` call sites use the new 4-arg signature, and the schema YAML validates with the new key present.
